title: Explain relational model in your own words. What problem does it solve, and can you give a simple example?
Imagine you are introducing relational model to a classmate. How does it work, and where would someone encounter it?
Compare relational model with documents and graphs. In what situations would you choose one over the other, and what practical factors influence that decision?

Consider this scenario: a product catalog needs consistent relationships. Explain how you would apply your understanding of relational model, what trade-offs or failure modes you would watch for, and how you would evaluate the result.
